description: A short briefing of what needs the owner's attention in this LetsBot workspace right now, in one call: conversations where a customer is still waiting for a reply (how many, how long the oldest has waited, and the first few names), customer messages and new contacts in the last 24 hours, WhatsApp/Messenger/Instagram/Telegram channels that are disconnected or lost access, a plan or trial that ends soon, and message usage close to the monthly limit. Use it when the user asks "what's new?", "anything urgent?", "give me a summary", or for a morning/daily briefing — especially by voice. `alerts` is already sorted most urgent first; read those first, in short sentences, in the user's language, and do not read out phone numbers or ids unless asked. For more detail use get_conversations_awaiting_reply or get_account_overview. With several workspaces, call it once per workspace (see list_workspaces). Read-only: it changes nothing, sends nothing and contacts no outside service.
name: get_owner_briefing
